hints: Standardise $x = 28.6$ using mean $\mu = 32.2$ and standard deviation $\sigma = 9.6$: $z = \dfrac{28.6 - 32.2}{9.6}$.
Use symmetry for the standard normal distribution: $\mathrm{P}(Z > -0.375) = \Phi(0.375)$.
Look up $\Phi(0.375)$ in the normal distribution tables and round to 3 significant figures.
walkthrough:
Express the probability in terms of the standard normal distribution $\Phi$:
$$\mathrm{P}(X > 28.6) = \mathrm{P}(Z > -0.375) = \Phi(0.375)$$

Look up $\Phi(0.375)$ in standard normal tables:
$$\Phi(0.375) \approx 0.6462$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Set up the random variable and parameters.
Let $X$ denote the time in minutes taken by an employee to complete the task:
$$X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^2) = N(32.2, 9.6^2)$$

Step 3: Evaluate $\mathrm{P}(Z > -0.375)$ using symmetry.
Because the normal curve is symmetric about 0, the upper tail from a negative value equals the cumulative probability from the corresponding positive value:
$$\mathrm{P}(Z > -0.375) = \mathrm{P}(Z < 0.375) = \Phi(0.375)$$

Step 4: Look up in standard normal tables:
$$\Phi(0.37) = 0.6443, \quad \text{difference for } 5 = 19 \implies \Phi(0.375) = 0.6462$$
Rounding to 3 significant figures gives $0.646$.

hints: The condition states that 20% of employees take longer than $t$ minutes: $\mathrm{P}(X > t) = 0.20$.
The cumulative probability to the left of $t$ is $\mathrm{P}(X < t) = 1 - 0.20 = 0.80$.
Look up the critical $Z$-score for $\Phi(z) = 0.80$ in normal tables: $z = 0.842$.
Set up the standardisation equation $\dfrac{t - 32.2}{9.6} = 0.842$ and solve for $t$.
walkthrough:
Translate the percentage condition into a cumulative probability:
$$\mathrm{P}(X > t) = 0.20 \implies \Phi(z) = 1 - 0.20 = 0.80$$

Find the critical value $z$ from the standard normal percentage points table:
$$\Phi(z) = 0.80 \implies z = 0.842$$

Substitute into the standardisation formula with $\mu = 32.2$ and $\sigma = 9.6$:
$$\frac{t - 32.2}{9.6} = 0.842$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Translate the problem into probability notation.
'20% of employees take longer than $t$ minutes' gives:
$$\mathrm{P}(X > t) = 0.20$$
Since the normal distribution is continuous, the area to the left of $t$ is:
$$\mathrm{P}(X < t) = 1 - 0.20 = 0.80$$

Step 2: Find the corresponding $Z$-score.
From the normal distribution tables for critical values:
$$\Phi(0.842) \approx 0.8000 \implies z = 0.842$$

Step 3: Standardise and solve for $t$:
$$\frac{t - \mu}{\sigma} = z$$
$$\frac{t - 32.2}{9.6} = 0.842$$
Multiply both sides by $9.6$:
$$t - 32.2 = 8.0832$$
Add $32.2$:
$$t = 32.2 + 8.0832 = 40.2832\text{ minutes}$$
Rounding to 3 significant figures gives $t = 40.3$ minutes (accept $40.28$ to $40.3$).

hints: Translate 'differs from the mean by less than 15.0 minutes' into an inequality: $|X - 32.2| < 15.0$.
This gives the interval $-15.0 < X - 32.2 < 15.0$, or $17.2 < X < 47.2$.
Use the central normal probability formula $\mathrm{P}(-z < Z < z) = 2\Phi(z) - 1$, where $z = 1.5625$.
walkthrough:
Express the condition in terms of the deviation from the mean $\mu = 32.2$:
$$\mathrm{P}(|X - 32.2| < 15.0) = \mathrm{P}(-15.0 < X - 32.2 < 15.0)$$

Standardise by dividing the deviation by $\sigma = 9.6$:
$$z = \frac{15.0}{9.6} = 1.5625$$
$$\mathrm{P}(-1.5625 < Z < 1.5625)$$

Apply the symmetric interval formula $2\Phi(z) - 1$:
$$\mathrm{P}(-1.5625 < Z < 1.5625) = 2\Phi(1.5625) - 1$$

Look up $\Phi(1.5625)$ in standard normal tables:
$$\Phi(1.5625) \approx 0.9409$$
$$\text{Probability} = 2(0.9409) - 1 = 1.8818 - 1 = 0.8818 \approx 0.882$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Translate the verbal statement into an inequality.
'The time taken differs from the mean by less than 15.0 minutes' means the absolute difference between $X$ and $\mu = 32.2$ is less than 15.0:
$$|X - 32.2| < 15.0$$
This is equivalent to the two-sided interval:
$$-15.0 < X - 32.2 < 15.0$$
Adding $32.2$ to all parts gives $17.2 < X < 47.2$.

Step 2: Standardise the bounds.
Since $Z = \frac{X - \mu}{\sigma}$, we divide the deviation $\pm 15.0$ by $\sigma = 9.6$:
$$z = \frac{15.0}{9.6} = \frac{25}{16} = 1.5625$$
So the required probability is:
$$\mathrm{P}(-1.5625 < Z < 1.5625)$$

Step 3: Evaluate using the symmetry of the standard normal distribution:
$$\mathrm{P}(-z < Z < z) = \Phi(z) - \Phi(-z) = \Phi(z) - (1 - \Phi(z)) = 2\Phi(z) - 1$$
Substitute $z = 1.5625$:
$$\mathrm{P}(-1.5625 < Z < 1.5625) = 2\Phi(1.5625) - 1$$

Step 4: Look up $\Phi(1.5625)$ in the tables:
$$\Phi(1.56) = 0.9406, \quad \text{difference for } 2 = 2 \implies \Phi(1.562) \approx 0.9408 \text{ to } 0.9409$$
$$2(0.9409) - 1 = 1.8818 - 1 = 0.8818$$
Rounding to 3 significant figures gives $0.882$.
